title: Matter Opening Intake Form
subtitle: A controlled intake and triage record for an approved representation moving into the firm's systems with exact client, scope, responsible team, engagement authority, billing, access, records, deadline, trust, legal-hold, and first-action controls, carrying facts and source evidence through qualified decision, exception escalation, secure communication, and accountable handoff.
description: This original Matter Opening Intake Form helps the new-business team and responsible lawyer manage an approved representation moving into the firm's systems with exact client, scope, responsible team, engagement authority, billing, access, records, deadline, trust, legal-hold, and first-action controls. It opens the record, classifies the request, captures source facts and urgency, and routes a qualified accept, defer, decline, or escalation decision, while keeping jurisdiction-specific conclusions and professional judgment with authorized reviewers.
use_case: Use when the new-business team and responsible lawyer needs one fillable record that opens the record, classifies the request, captures source facts and urgency, and routes a qualified accept, defer, decline, or escalation decision for the new matter setup. Close only after the intake disposition is supported by evidence and accepted by the named recipient.

sections.title: Matter Opening record identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, establish authority, and assign accountable qualified review.

blocks.label: Matter Opening record and responsible parties
Intake and Triage timing and route

blocks.guidance: Use approved secure systems for protected communications and source files. Do not enter access credentials, complete account numbers, government identifiers, medical detail, or privileged source content in this routing form.

sections.title: Matter Opening facts and source evidence
sections.guidance: Capture domain-specific facts, distinguish statements from verified evidence, and retain source references.

blocks.label: Matter Opening matter profile
Matter Opening evidence checkpoints
items: Client identity matches conflict clearance and engagement records
Matter scope and exclusions match the authorized engagement
Responsible lawyer, team roles, office, and supervision are assigned
Billing terms, payer authority, retainer, and trust handling are routed
Known deadlines are entered into the approved docketing process
Document workspace, confidentiality wall, and access groups are established
Legal hold, preservation, or special handling requirements are evaluated
First client communication and immediate work assignment are scheduled
blocks.guidance: Check only supported items; explain any limitation in the evidence narrative.

sections.title: Matter Opening intake and triage control record
sections.guidance: Turn the record purpose into traceable evidence, accountable actions, and reviewable decisions.

blocks.label: Requested outcome, contact, and triage basis
Matter Opening intake interview controls
items: The approved client describes the requested outcome in their own terms
The new matter setup is classified before any substantive action
Material dates, amounts, persons, and assumptions are read back for confirmation
Statements are visibly separated from verified records and third-party reports
Only necessary information is requested through an approved secure route
Language, access, accommodation, and communication needs are routed
No promise of representation, result, filing, clearance, or deadline action is made
Urgent, suspicious, unsafe, or professionally restricted matters are escalated

sections.title: Matter Opening stop conditions, exceptions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Stop when authority, identity, evidence, deadline, confidentiality, or professional-duty controls are unresolved.

blocks.label: Stop and escalate when any condition is present
items: Conflict clearance is missing, expired, conditional, or for different parties
Engagement scope, client identity, or payer authority does not match
A deadline is known but not yet verified and independently docketed
Trust funds, advance fees, settlement funds, or client property need special handling
Confidentiality wall, restricted access, protective order, or security control is missing
Records retention, legal hold, data residency, or transfer duties are unresolved
Staffing, licensure, admission, insurance, or supervision requirements are unmet
Work has started before required approval, authorization, or matter setup
blocks.guidance: A checked item requires immediate protective action, a named owner, qualified review, and a final disposition.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage exception and escalation register
Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed

fields.label: Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed

blocks.label: Qualified review and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records operational facts and does not determine legal rights, professional duties, privilege, conflicts, consentability, deadlines, or court compliance. Follow applicable jurisdictional rules and current firm policy; route legal, ethics, privacy, tax, court, safety, and specialist questions to authorized reviewers.

sections.title: Matter Opening qualified decision and accountable authorization
sections.guidance: Record the authorized decision separately from preliminary analysis and prevent action beyond its evidence and scope.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage qualified decision
Matter Opening decision and execution conditions
items: Conflict clearance and every opening condition apply to the exact matter
Engagement authority, scope, exclusions, and client decision maker are verified
Responsible lawyer accepts supervision, deadlines, staffing, and communication duties
Billing, trust, payer, invoice, and expense routes match approved terms
Information governance and restricted-access settings are independently checked
Opening approval identifies any condition that blocks substantive work
blocks.guidance: Check only controls supported by cited evidence; unresolved items remain open conditions.

blocks.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up

fields.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up

blocks.label: Preparation, qualified review, and independent authorization
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and scope; they do not replace required agreements, consents, notices, filings, or system approvals.

blocks.label: Decision-use limitation
blocks.guidance: Do not use this Matter Opening record as a substitute for legal advice, a required client agreement, informed consent, court paper, discovery response, privilege review, or specialist determination. Execute only the action evidenced in the approved system of record.

sections.title: Matter Opening completion, evidence reconciliation, and handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when the outcome is evidenced, limitations remain visible, and every open action has an accountable owner.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage outcome and primary handoff
Matter Opening closeout evidence
items: Matter number and approved system links are reconciled to the opening request
Responsible team and client contact receive the opening confirmation
First deadlines and reminders are confirmed in the docketing system
First work assignment, owner, due point, and evidence location are recorded
Conditional setup tasks remain visible with escalation and completion owners
Opening record is accepted by the responsible lawyer or authorized delegate
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items require an exception disposition or a documented reopen trigger.
